In toPackedFloat we represent floating point numbers with mantissa size either 38 or 72 depending upon the floating point size. If the mantissa is not exactly 38 or 72 digit long we normalize it, i.e, convert it to either 38  digit or 72 digit long mantissa. And to decide whether the given input mantissa should be normalized to M_MANTISSA (38) or L_MANTISSA (72) we use a `isResultL` bool that checks if the `MAXIMUM_EXPONENT` is signed less than the `mantissaMultiplier + exponent`. safety.text: Floating point numbers with 38 < digits < 72, which are valid inputs, should be normalized to the L_MANTISSA (72) range so their precision is preserved.
